text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down 2–3% over the past day, with altcoins like Solana falling harder at nearly 5%, signaling broad-based selling pressure across risk assets. The Fear & Greed Index sits at 20—extreme fear territory—though it has risen 9 points over the week, suggesting some recovery in sentiment despite today's losses. Bitcoin dominance holding at 56% and moderate 24-hour volume of $71B indicate traders are rotating toward the largest cryptocurrencies rather than exiting entirely, a pattern typical of retracement rather than capitulation.
